product_overview: A single-page service management app for creating and managing work orders and client records. It supports viewing order details and printing reports. All data is stored in a local SQLite database on a single computer (no remote backend).
core_goals: Create new service orders for clients with motor details, service items, and payment information
Search and review client history and detailed information
View, edit, print, and conclude service orders

features.name: New Work Order Creation
features.description: Allows users to create a new service order linked to a client, including motor specifications, parts, service items, and payment details.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the new service order flow -> Select a client from the available suggestions -> Select the motor model and enter displacement -> Choose received parts and additional needed parts -> Add service items and assign values -> Record initial payment and discount -> Save the service order

Navigate to / -> Open the new service order flow -> Attempt to save the order without completing required fields -> See validation feedback and complete the missing information -> Save the service order

features.name: Client Registration
features.description: Allows users to add new clients with identification and contact details, and classify them by client type.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the clients section -> Start adding a new client -> Enter name, document number, phone, WhatsApp, and city -> Choose the client type -> Save the client record

Navigate to / -> Open the clients section -> Start adding a new client -> Leave required client information incomplete or invalid -> See validation feedback and correct the entered data -> Save the client record

features.name: Client Search and Filter
features.description: Allows users to search client records, review filtered results, and open a client’s overview and history.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the clients section -> Enter search terms in the search field -> Review the filtered client list -> Open a client record to view its detailed overview and history

features.name: Service Order Modal Viewer
features.description: Allows users to inspect a service order in detail, print its report, edit it, or conclude it from a modal view.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open a service order from the dashboard or history list -> Review the service items, parts, and financial breakdown -> Open the print report flow to generate a printable view -> Conclude the order after confirming the details

Navigate to / -> Open a service order from the dashboard or history list -> Review the service items, parts, and financial breakdown -> Start editing the order -> Update the order data -> Save the changes

Navigate to / -> Open a service order from the dashboard or history list -> Review the service items, parts, and financial breakdown -> Attempt to conclude the order with incomplete or invalid information -> See validation feedback and correct the data -> Conclude the order

routes.description: Main single-page application dashboard and views

features.name: New Work Order Creation
features.description: Create a service order associated with a client, motor specifications, service items, and payment details
user_interactions: Click "Nova O.S. Rápida" or navigate to "Nova O.S."
Select a client from autocomplete dropdown
Select motor model and input displacement
Choose parts received and additional parts needed
Add service items and values
Record initial payment and discount
Click "Gerar Ordem de Serviço" to save

features.name: Client Registration
user_interactions: Click "Clientes" in sidebar
Click "Adicionar Cliente"
Fill in name, document (CPF/CNPJ), phone, WhatsApp, and city
Choose client type (Regular or Mechanic)
Click "Salvar Cliente"

features.name: Client Search and Filter
user_interactions: Type search terms in the search bar of the clients page
Review filtered list of clients
Click a client to load detailed overview and history

features.name: Service Order Modal Viewer
features.description: View, edit, print, or conclude service orders
user_interactions: Click on any order row in dashboard or history
See detailed services, pieces, and financial breakdown
Click "IMPRIMIR RELATÓRIO" to open print menu
Click "CONCLUIR" to finish order
Click "EDITAR O.S." to modify data
